name: LinuxCNC 5ax TCP
description: Millimetre RS274 dialect for LinuxCNC indexed 3+2 and continuous five-axis with TCP. Absolute moves, cutter compensation cancelled, IJK arcs and helices. A axis with inverse-time feed (G93, cancelled by G94) when the angle changes. The machine must run TCP kinematics (for example xyzac-trt-kins, xyzbc-trt-kins, or switchkins); G-code programs the tool tip in the part frame together with the rotary words. On and off hooks are empty because the switching codes are configuration-specific. A rapid that changes a rotary is G1 under G93 at 5000 mm/min. Pivots are measured from the G54 origin. This output has not been proven on a machine.
references: TCP is a kinematics-module property; G-code programs the tool tip in the work frame. https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/motion/5-axis-kinematics.html
Switching codes such as remapped M428/M429 are configuration-specific. https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/motion/switchkins.html
